description: Capability + runner registry. CAPABILITIES are skills an agent can have (one per agent). RUNNERS map (capability, column) → an executable flow. Adding a new runner = add an entry here + (optionally) create the personality_file + (if no existing handler fits) implement a handler in server/src/services/agentRunner.js. The personality_file is ADDITIVE context — if missing, the runner still works via a baked-in baseline. context_docs is the static map of which docs/ files get bundled into an agent's starting context for that capability (every app agent gets docs/rules.md today; AutoKan-internal docs like api.md/frontend.md map to no capability on purpose). README.md is added on top for is_coder capabilities. Changes apply on next server restart for runners, or on `npm run db:reset` for capabilities.

capabilities.label: Planner
capabilities.description: Plans tasks — clarifies requirements through Q&A before any work begins. Acts like a project manager on a software team.

capabilities.label: Coder
capabilities.description: Implements code that satisfies an approved task. Full write access inside client/. Defaults to human action on hindrance.

capabilities.label: Code Test Runner
capabilities.description: Runs the project's automated test suite and reports pass/fail. Narrow scope — escalates anything that needs non-shell verification.

capabilities.label: UX Coder
capabilities.description: Frontend UX-specialised tasks — layout, styling, interaction patterns. Scoped to app/src/.

capabilities.label: Architect
capabilities.description: Designs system foundations and high-level structure. Produces written proposals.

capabilities.label: Code Reviewer
capabilities.description: Reads and understands code but cannot modify it. For review, audit, or observer agents.

capabilities.label: Migration Handler
capabilities.description: Data migrations and schema changes. Touches only migration files.

capabilities.label: Network Tester
capabilities.description: Network testing and external endpoint checks. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Cloud Operator
capabilities.description: Cloud environment access — health checks, deployment status, safe operational commands.

capabilities.label: Security Reviewer
capabilities.description: Security analysis and vulnerability review. Never modifies files.

capabilities.label: Log Analyst
capabilities.description: Reads and summarises logs from the filesystem and cloud.

capabilities.label: Data Analyst
capabilities.description: Extracts and analyses data from project areas. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Document Producer
capabilities.description: Produces structured documents, SOPs, checklists, and summaries as markdown output in the client outputs folder. Used for non-software sectors where the deliverable is a document rather than code.

capabilities.label: Document Verifier
capabilities.description: Reads documents and files from the client folder, checks structure and content against criteria in instruction files, and produces a pass/fail verification report. Never writes to source files.

runners.description: PM clarifies requirements with the human through Q&A. Single-shot per turn — sleeps between human answers.
Developer implements task in a git worktree, pushes feature branch, server opens a PR. Auto-merges if task.auto_complete = true.

on_pass.message: Tests passed — ready for human sign-off

on_fail_retry.message: Tests failed — sent back to In Progress

runners.description: Runs the project's automated test suite (npm test / pytest / etc), writes missing coverage tests, reports pass/fail. Narrow scope — escalates anything not shell-validatable. Fail retries once before escalating.
